name: Takehara Kaori
source:
One day, the landlord introduced to me a mysterious, kimono-clad beauty.

She must be a married woman because her husband was mentioned....

[spoiler]a debt incurred by her husband is being paid off  by offering her sexual services to the landlord. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/tmhv.html]official site[/url]]
